profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
C/C++, CUDA, GPU, OpenGL, GLSL, OpenCV coding and debugging experience in computer graphics, computer vision.
Android, Java, Swift, Objective-C, Node.js and Python coding and debugging experience.
OOP modeling and implementation experience.
GUI development with Qt framework. 
Skillful with data structure, efficient algorithm, search and sort algorithms.
Platforms: Windows XP/Win7/Win8, Linux Ubuntu/Redhat.
Strong problem solving, quick learner and work hard.
source control: SVN, Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android coding for audio processing, noise detection, and glass break detection for security panels. 
Create a service in the back end to get a signal from the microphone in C/C++ with OpenSLES.
Face recognition and motion detection with OpenCV in Android/ JNI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Coding with LUA, ActionScript for GUI, and center console display in the HMI team.
image processing: Lighting, blur, contrast, histogram.
Build car infotainment system with UI Composer from Nvidia and Flash Builder.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: Working in Endopillow project in Ruhrlandklinik, Germany. A lung research project and graphic programming with C#.

positions.title: PhD Candidate
positions.description:
CS Dep., Dortmund University, Germany. “SAM” Semi-Automatic Modeling, application program Visual C++ with OpenGL, Qt, 3D modeling in which railway can be modeled. The project focuses on the following research directions: 

Image processing and 3D image converting, Mesh creating and editing. Triangulation methods. Google Earth terrains mesh reconstruction. Curves drawing and implementation such as: B-spline, Bezier, cubic spline, circular arc and Clothoid curves. Routes planning and A* algorithm. Automatically drawing of constructions and animation creation with OpenGL.

volunteerExperiences.description: Help to teach how to take care children health. Inform the class to the community, organize the class.
